=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- tests/test_phase_wrapper_predicate_contract.py
Line or code reference: 164-165
Problem: `expected_uses` is constructed as `...@stable` but the README now uses `...@<40-character-release-sha> # stable`. `yaml.safe_load` strips the `# stable` comment, leaving `uses:` as `...@<40-character-release-sha>`, which never equals the hardcoded `@stable` expectation.
Why it fails at runtime: The `lint` job runs this test on every CI run. The assertion at line 165 fails for all three `README_WRAPPER_EXAMPLES` (clarify, plan, implement) because the parsed YAML `uses` value is the literal placeholder `@<40-character-release-sha>`, not `@stable`. CI run 33723955367 proves this with `AssertionError` at exactly this line.
SEVERITY: BLOCKER
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- `.github/workflows/mark-stable.yml:679-684` and `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:5145-5150` (SHA format not validated before dispatch): The code DOES validate. Lines 680-683 read `if [[ ! "${RELEASE_SHA}" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$ ]]; then echo "::error::Could not peel ${VERSION} to a 40-character release commit SHA."; exit 1; fi`. The finding is factually incorrect.
- `.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:385-386` (misleading comment): The last run diff already corrected this comment to "Refresh it when present, but never auto-create it, to avoid bootstrap loops." The current text is accurate. Already satisfied.
- `scripts/workflow_wrapper_refs.py:38-40` (ValueError on no coding-workflows ref): Intentional fail-closed design. The renderer only processes `workflow-templates/*.yml` files, all 16 of which contain coding-workflows `@stable` refs.
- `.github/workflows/audit_consumer_drift.yml:56-61` (shallow fetch concern): Standard CI pattern. `git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin refs/tags/stable` fetches exactly the tag ref, and `FETCH_HEAD^{commit}` peels the annotated tag to its commit.
- `.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:73-77` (shallow clone concern): The `git clone --depth 1 --no-checkout` is followed by `git fetch --force --no-tags --depth 1 origin "${TEMPLATES_REF}"` at line 79 which explicitly fetches the tag ref.
- TASK_GAP about `internal-*.yml @main` pins: The README explicitly documents that internal wrappers intentionally use `@main`; the linked issue targets consumer delivery, not internal dogfooding.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
